title: discovery.py: RREP hop_count overflow causes serialization failure at max depth
description: Line 181: install_hops = rrep.hop_count + 1 can exceed MAX_HOP_LIMIT (15) when processing an RREP at maximum hop depth. This value propagates to GradientEntry (line 189) and is used in proxied RREPs (line 169) and forwarded RREPs (line 216). When these RREPs are serialized via to_bytes(), messages.py line 124 raises LoadngError because hop_count > MAX_HOP_LIMIT. Failure scenario: valid RREP with hop_count=15 arrives, install_hops becomes 16, subsequent RREP generation/forwarding raises exception causing route delivery failure.
